CASE PUD 2026-000046 ENTRY NO. 61 FILED IN OCC COURT CLERK'S OFFICE ON 10/05/2026 - PAGE 1 OF 1




                             BEFORE THE CORPORATION COMMISSION OF OKLAHOMA

         IN THE MATTER OF THE APPLICATION OF
         OKLAHOMA GAS AND ELECTRIC COMPANY
         FOR AN ORDER OF THE COMMISSION
         APPROVING ITS NEW EXTRA LARGE LOAD
         TARIFF AND TERMS AND CONDITIONS OF
         SERVICE FOR EXTRA LARGE LOAD                         CAUSE NO. PUD2026-000046
         CUSTOMERS AND A REGULATORY ASSET
         TO RECOVER COSTS ASSOCIATED WITH
         PORTFOLIO OPTIMIZATION SOFTWARE



                                           NOTICE OF HEARING

                NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that Oklahoma Industrial Energy Consumers ("OIEC")
         filed Objections to Certain of Oklahoma Gas and Electric Company's Data Requests in this case.

               NOTICE IS FURTHER GIVEN that a hearing on the Objections to Certain of Oklahoma
         Gas and Electric Company's Data Requests shall be set before an Administrative Law Judge on
         October 8, 2026, at 8:30am, at Will Rogers Memorial Office Building, 2401 N. Lincoln Blvd., in
         the Capitol Complex, Oklahoma City, Oklahoma 73 105.

                NOTICE IS FURTHER GIVEN that the undersigned counsel has conferred with
         representatives of all parties to this matter and all have agreed to waive notice requirements
         concerning the above-setting.

                 NOTICE IS FURTHER GIVEN that all interested persons may appear and be heard and
         that after hearing and consideration of the recommendations of the Administrative Law Judge, the
         Commission shall issue such order and grant such relief as it deems reasonable, fair, necessary,
         proper, and equitable in the premises, whether or not specifically prayed for in the Motion.

                NOTICE IS FURTHER GIVEN that for further information concerning this Motion,
         contact Eric C. Money, HALL, ESTILL, HARDWICK, GABLE, GOLDEN & NELSON, P.C.,
         100 North Broadway, Suite 2900, Telephone: (405) 553-2870. Email: emonev@hallestill.com

                  OKLAHOMA CORPORATION COMMISSION

                  KIM DAVID, Chairman
                  BRIAN BINGMAN, Commissioner
                  J. TODD HIETT, Commissioner


                                                     Eric C. Money, OBA No. 22654
